section_1_cloze.passage:

At that moment, I suddenly felt a sense of [45] and realized that I needed to make a change and [46] myself. In the first few weeks, my instructor was quite [49] my sincerity and abilities. This was a vital moment — it made me realize how [50] it is for a person to discover their [51] and fully pursue it. When my parents expressed their complete admiration for my performance, my dignity was largely [54].
Now, I work as a lifeguard, a mountaineer, and a coach. If there's one thing I've learned, it's that you just need to give yourself a [55]. Everything I've done has been driven by a single goal — to realize my potential.

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。上下文依据：根据前文的“I had little interest in many subjects”以及后文的“unsuccessful in almost all I attempted”可知，作者在学业上很挣扎，无法“认识到/发觉”自己的能力（what I was capable of）。易错点：可能误选C(accept)，但“接受”能力不如“发觉/认识到”潜力符合语境逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(deny)：语境句：He could not deny the fact that he had made a serious mistake. 固定搭配：deny doing sth, deny access to
B(recognize)：语境句：It is important to recognize the value of traditional culture. 固定搭配：recognize... as..., recognize one's potential
C(accept)：语境句：She decided to accept the job offer after careful consideration. 固定搭配：accept an invitation, accept the truth
D(abandon)：语境句：The sailors had to abandon the sinking ship to save their lives. 固定搭配：abandon a plan, abandon oneself to

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上下文依据：因为在几乎所有尝试中都以失败告终，所以作者失去了“尊严/自信”(dignity)。且后文第54题“my dignity was largely restored”形成了明确的词汇复现。易错点：容易误选A(patience)或B(focus)，但在连遭失败后自我评价降低，dignity更能体现内心的挫败感与上下文呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(patience)：语境句：Learning a foreign language requires a lot of time and patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, lose patience
B(focus)：语境句：The main focus of the meeting was on how to improve efficiency. 固定搭配：focus on, lose focus
C(dignity)：语境句：He accepted the criticism with quiet dignity. 固定搭配：maintain one's dignity, lose dignity
D(sympathy)：语境句：We all have profound sympathy for the victims of the earthquake. 固定搭配：feel sympathy for, out of sympathy

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。上下文依据：由于失去了尊严和自信，作者甚至有一段时间不愿与周围的任何人“交流/互动”(interact with)。易错点：可能误选C(cooperate)，但interact范围更广，强调日常的人际交往，符合作者封闭自我的状态。
questions.supplement:
A(fight)：语境句：They had to fight against extreme weather conditions during the expedition. 固定搭配：fight for, fight against
B(negotiate)：语境句：The government refused to negotiate with the terrorists. 固定搭配：negotiate with, negotiate a contract
C(cooperate)：语境句：We need to cooperate closely to complete the project on time. 固定搭配：cooperate with sb, cooperate in doing sth
D(interact)：语境句：Teachers should encourage students to interact with each other in class. 固定搭配：interact with, social interaction

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。上下文依据：Things didn't improve until... 是一个典型的not...until...结构，结合后文作者看到孩子们快乐游泳受到启发，说明直到那个阳光明媚的下午，低迷的状况才有所“改善/好转”(improve)。易错点：可能会选A(settle)，但事物或状况本身的好转习惯用improve。
questions.supplement:
A(settle)：语境句：It took them several months to settle the dispute. 固定搭配：settle down, settle a dispute
B(work)：语境句：His strategy didn't work, so he had to try another approach. 固定搭配：work out, work on
C(improve)：语境句：Reading English newspapers can help improve your vocabulary. 固定搭配：improve on/upon, room for improvement
D(worsen)：语境句：The weather is expected to worsen by tomorrow morning. 固定搭配：worsen the situation, continually worsen

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上下文依据：看到孩子们在游泳池里快乐游泳，作者突然产生了一种“灵感/启发”(inspiration)，意识到自己需要改变。易错点：容易误选B(peace)，但peace(平静)无法导致后面“意识到需要重塑自我”这种强烈的行动渴望。
questions.supplement:
A(regret)：语境句：Much to my regret, I am unable to accept your kind invitation. 固定搭配：express regret, feel regret for
B(peace)：语境句：After years of war, the country finally achieved lasting peace. 固定搭配：in peace, keep the peace
C(achievement)：语境句：Winning the gold medal was his greatest athletic achievement. 固定搭配：a sense of achievement, make an achievement
D(inspiration)：语境句：Nature has always been a major source of inspiration for artists. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a flash of inspiration

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。上下文依据：作者意识到需要做出改变，“重塑”(reinvent)自己。reinvent oneself 是非常地道的固定搭配，意为“改头换面、重新做人”。易错点：可能误选B(express)，但express oneself（表达自己）不足以体现作者渴望彻底改变失败现状的决心。
questions.supplement:
A(reinvent)：语境句：After losing his job, he decided to reinvent himself as a writer. 固定搭配：reinvent oneself, reinvent the wheel
B(express)：语境句：Words cannot express how grateful I am for your help. 固定搭配：express oneself, express an opinion
C(surprise)：语境句：The outcome of the election didn't surprise anyone. 固定搭配：to one's surprise, catch sb by surprise
D(question)：语境句：It is healthy to question what you read on the internet. 固定搭配：out of the question, without question

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上下文依据：作者认为去学习一项新的“技能”(skill)并融入新群体会很有帮助。后文紧接着提到报名了“游泳课”，游泳正是一项具体技能。易错点：容易误选B(routine)，但routine指日常常规，不符合报班学习的具体动作。
questions.supplement:
A(concept)：语境句：It is difficult for children to grasp the abstract concept of time. 固定搭配：a basic concept, grasp the concept
B(routine)：语境句：Exercise has become an essential part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
C(skill)：语境句：Communication is a vital skill for succeeding in the workplace. 固定搭配：develop a skill, practical skill
D(insight)：语境句：The book provides deep insight into the complex issue of global warming. 固定搭配：gain insight into, provide insight

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。上下文依据：结合上文决定学习新技能，所以作者“报名参加”(signed up for)了游泳课。易错点：其他选项put together for(凑集), kept up with(跟上), dropped out of(辍学/退出) 在逻辑上均不符合开始上课的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(put together for)：语境句：We put together a proposal for the upcoming charity event. 固定搭配：put together, pull together
B(kept up with)：语境句：He found it hard to keep up with the rest of the class in math. 固定搭配：keep up with, catch up with
C(dropped out of)：语境句：Due to severe financial problems, she dropped out of college. 固定搭配：drop out, drop by
D(signed up for)：语境句：Many students have signed up for the volunteer program this summer. 固定搭配：sign up, sign in

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词短语辨析。上下文依据：教练对作者的真诚和能力留下了“深刻印象”(impressed with)。这种正向反馈为后文作者获得动力、发掘潜能并在比赛中获奖奠定了基础。易错点：可能误选D(critical of)，若教练持批评态度，则无法合理构成下文所说的vital moment（关键时刻）带来的积极转变。
questions.supplement:
A(impressed with)：语境句：The manager was deeply impressed with her excellent presentation skills. 固定搭配：be impressed with/by, leave an impression
B(concerned with)：语境句：This chapter is mainly concerned with the historical background. 固定搭配：be concerned with, as far as I am concerned
C(dismissive of)：语境句：Some people are dismissive of the potential risks of AI technology. 固定搭配：be dismissive of, dismiss sb/sth as
D(critical of)：语境句：The report is highly critical of the company's environmental record. 固定搭配：be critical of, critical thinking

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。上下文依据：教练的认可是转折点，这让作者意识到发现自己潜能并全力追求它是多么“关键/至关重要”(crucial)。易错点：可能误选C(unforgettable)，放在it is...for sb to do句型中不如crucial合适，此处强调该行动的重要性而非难忘。
questions.supplement:
A(alarming)：语境句：The rainforest is disappearing at an alarming rate. 固定搭配：an alarming rate, sound the alarm
B(crucial)：语境句：Diet and exercise play a crucial role in maintaining good health. 固定搭配：play a crucial role, it is crucial that
C(unforgettable)：语境句：My trip to the Great Wall was a truly unforgettable experience. 固定搭配：an unforgettable experience, unforgettable memories
D(confusing)：语境句：The instructions on the box are rather confusing for beginners. 固定搭配：highly confusing, find sth confusing

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上下文依据：呼应文章第一段的“what I was capable of”以及文章结尾的“to realize my potential”，此处意指一个人发现自己的“潜能”(potential)。易错点：可能误选B(success)，但success通常是被追求的结果，而不是被“发现”的内在特质。
questions.supplement:
A(potential)：语境句：The coach believes that the young athlete has great potential. 固定搭配：realize one's potential, tap into potential
B(success)：语境句：Hard work and determination are the keys to success. 固定搭配：achieve success, a great success
C(secret)：语境句：The recipe for this delicious cake is a closely guarded family secret. 固定搭配：keep a secret, in secret
D(fortune)：语境句：He made a large fortune by investing in real estate. 固定搭配：make a fortune, seek one's fortune

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。上下文依据：根据后文的“in local swim meets and even won a few medals”（参加当地游泳比赛并获奖）可知，作者不再仅仅是休闲游泳，而是作为选手“竞争性地/竞技性地”(competitively)游泳。易错点：容易误选D(smoothly)，但smoothly无法精准体现出参加正式比赛并获奖的竞技属性。
questions.supplement:
A(nervously)：语境句：She waited nervously for her turn for the job interview. 固定搭配：smile nervously, wait nervously
B(competitively)：语境句：To survive in this market, companies must price their products competitively. 固定搭配：swim competitively, price competitively
C(properly)：语境句：Make sure the equipment is working properly before using it. 固定搭配：behave properly, function properly
D(smoothly)：语境句：Thanks to everyone's effort, the event went smoothly. 固定搭配：run smoothly, go smoothly

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。上下文依据：根据后文的“and finally went to college”可知，作者不仅在游泳上取得成就，由于自信心的恢复，在“学业上的”(academic)成绩也取得了令人惊讶的进步。易错点：结合第一段提到的school years were a struggle，只有学业上的进步才能通往大学，其他选项均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(administrative)：语境句：The school hired a new assistant to handle administrative tasks. 固定搭配：administrative staff, administrative duties
B(technological)：语境句：We live in an age of rapid technological advancement. 固定搭配：technological innovation, technological progress
C(academic)：语境句：The university provides scholarships for students with outstanding academic records. 固定搭配：academic performance, academic achievement
D(economic)：语境句：The country is currently facing severe economic challenges. 固定搭配：economic growth, economic development

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。上下文依据：父母对作者的表现表达了钦佩，这种肯定使作者失去的尊严在很大程度上得到了“恢复”(restored)，与前文第42空的lost my dignity形成完美闭环。易错点：如果不注意前文伏笔，可能会觉得其他词也能通顺，但在文中语境下restored最为贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(restored)：语境句：The ancient temple was carefully restored to its former glory. 固定搭配：restore health, restore order
B(ruined)：语境句：The heavy rain completely ruined our picnic plans. 固定搭配：ruin one's reputation, in ruins
C(observed)：语境句：Scientists carefully observed the behavior of the monkeys in the wild. 固定搭配：observe the law, observe a star
D(revealed)：语境句：The investigation revealed the truth behind the mysterious accident. 固定搭配：reveal a secret, reveal the truth

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。上下文依据：结合作者自身从失败到重塑自我的经历，他总结出最重要的一点就是你需要给自己一个“机会”(chance)。易错点：可能误选A(blessing)或C(reward)，但give oneself a chance是地道且常见的励志表达，契合主动尝试新事物的文章主旨。
questions.supplement:
A(blessing)：语境句：The sudden rain was a blessing for the drought-stricken farmers. 固定搭配：a blessing in disguise, count one's blessings
B(plan)：语境句：Everything went exactly according to the original plan. 固定搭配：make a plan, carry out a plan
C(reward)：语境句：He received a generous financial reward for his outstanding contribution. 固定搭配：in reward for, reap the rewards
D(chance)：语境句：Please give me a second chance to prove my ability. 固定搭配：by chance, take a chance

vocab_pack.definition_en: a difficult or challenging situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语，与were构成系表结构，表示过去的状态（我的早年学校生活是一场挣扎）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The early years of the business were a struggle.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 生意的早年是一段艰难的时期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My early school years were a struggle.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to not be interested in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 谓语动词had为have的过去式，little表示否定意义，in后接名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has little interest in fashion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对时尚没什么兴趣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had little interest in many subjects

vocab_pack.definition_en: having the ability or potential to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式was，后接形容词capable，再接介词of+从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is capable of solving complex problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他有能力解决复杂的问题。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to lose self-respect or sense of worth
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式lost，后接代词所有格my+dignity，表示个人尊严的丧失。
vocab_pack.example_en: He lost his dignity after the scandal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 丑闻之后他失去了尊严。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to communicate or engage with someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形interact，句中用于否定结构“would never interact with”，would为情态动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's important to interact with colleagues.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与同事互动很重要。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become better
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用于否定形式didn't improve，一般过去时，improve为原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: His grades improved after extra tutoring.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 课后辅导后他的成绩提高了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a feeling of being mentally stimulated to do something creative
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作felt的宾语，不定冠词a+sense+of+inspiration。
vocab_pack.example_en: She felt a sense of inspiration after the speech.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 演讲后她感到一阵鼓舞。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to alter one's situation or behavior
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形短语，句中用于“needed to make a change”，make为原形（不定式）。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's never too late to make a change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 做出改变永远不晚。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change oneself significantly, especially to become more successful
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形reinvent oneself，句中用reinvent myself，myself为反身代词，与主语I一致。
vocab_pack.example_en: After years in finance, he reinvented himself as a teacher.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在金融行业多年后，他重塑自我成为了一名教师。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enroll in or register for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式signed up for，后接名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She signed up for a yoga class.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她报名参加了一个瑜伽班。
vocab_pack.from_passage: signed up for a swimming course

vocab_pack.definition_en: a class or program to learn swimming
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定冠词a+swimming（动名词作定语）+course。
vocab_pack.example_en: He took a swimming course last summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他去年夏天上了游泳课。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a favorable opinion about someone/something due to their qualities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式was，后跟副词quite，再跟过去分词impressed+with。被动含义（主语是instructor）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The judges were impressed with her performance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 评委们对她的表演印象深刻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was quite impressed with my sincerity

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being honest and genuine
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，句中作介词with的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her sincerity won everyone's trust.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的真诚赢得了大家的信任。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very important or critical point in time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作表语，不定冠词a+vital+moment。
vocab_pack.example_en: This was a vital moment in the negotiations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是谈判中的关键时刻。

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely important or essential
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用于how crucial it is...，作表语，it为形式主语，真正主语为不定式to discover...。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is crucial to maintain good health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保持健康至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how crucial it is for a person to discover...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find out one's hidden abilities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形discover，句中用discover their potential，their为形容词性物主代词，potential不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Education helps students discover their potential.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教育帮助学生发掘他们的潜力。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow or chase something (a goal)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形，句中与副词fully搭配，后接代词it。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to pursue her dream.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决定追求自己的梦想。

vocab_pack.definition_en: with the passage of time, over time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 从句中用as引导，谓语动词go by，句中为过去时went by。
vocab_pack.example_en: As days go by, he becomes more confident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着时间的推移，他变得更加自信。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to swim in races or with a competitive spirit
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为动名词短语作began的宾语，原形swim competitively。
vocab_pack.example_en: He started to swim competitively at age 10.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他10岁时开始竞技性游泳。

vocab_pack.definition_en: an event where swimming competitions take place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，作介词in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She won three gold medals at the swim meet.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在游泳比赛中赢得了三枚金牌。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive a medal as a prize
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式won，后接不定冠词a few+medals。
vocab_pack.example_en: The athlete won a medal at the Olympics.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位运动员在奥运会上赢得了一枚奖牌。

vocab_pack.definition_en: progress or betterment in studies
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式作宾语，与动词made搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular revision leads to academic improvement.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 定期复习导致学业进步。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attend university
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式went to college，go的过去时。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students go to college after high school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生高中毕业后上大学。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or say that you admire someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式expressed，后接形容词所有格their complete admiration。
vocab_pack.example_en: The audience expressed admiration for the singer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 观众表达了对歌手的钦佩。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring back one's self-respect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，过去时was restored，主语my dignity，largely为副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The apology helped restore her dignity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 道歉帮助恢复了她的尊严。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a job as something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在时work as，后接职业名词（lifeguard...）。
vocab_pack.example_en: She works as a translator.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她担任翻译工作。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to allow oneself the opportunity to succeed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原形give，反身代词yourself，句中为need to give...。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should give yourself a chance to learn.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该给自己一个学习的机会。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be motivated or caused by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时的被动语态has been driven by。
vocab_pack.example_en: His success is driven by hard work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的成功是由努力工作驱动的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has been driven by a single goal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to achieve or fulfill one's ability
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式to realize，后接代词my potential。
vocab_pack.example_en: She finally realized her potential as a writer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她最终实现了作为作家的潜力。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to acquire the ability to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，learn为原形，a new skill为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's useful to learn a skill like cooking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学习像烹饪这样的技能很有用。

section_2_word_form.passage:
A standout tradition in Guangzhou is Yum Cha, [56] meaning "drinking tea." Yum Cha is more than just a drink — it's a kind of social activity and a distinct characteristic of Lingnan culture, [57] in family gatherings, business meetings, or casual chats among friends.
Early-rising [58], especially seniors, usually greet each other with "Have you drunk tea?" to start the day. A native saying, "The only thing [59] can interrupt a Yum Cha gathering is a typhoon," jokingly but vividly [60] the strong commitment of Guangzhou people to their daily tea tradition. In teahouses or restaurants, people come together [61] a wide variety of traditional bite-sized foods, enjoying the social atmosphere and rich cultural heritage(遗产) that accompany the meal, which adds [62] touch of depth and enjoyment to the tea gathering.
Over the last ten years, the tradition of Yum Cha [63] by many young people as a way to reconnect with their roots. Moreover, they are innovating on the classic Yum Cha by experimenting [64] low-sugar, low-oil, and high-fiber dim sum(点心), using recyclable and eco-friendly tea ware. This [65] of tradition and innovation helps ensure that Yum Cha culture remains relevant in today's fast-paced world.

questions.explanation: 考查副词。此处需要副词修饰后面的动名词meaning，意为“字面上地”。易错点：可能拼写错误漏写一个l。
questions.supplement: 正确形(literally)：语境句：I was literally scared to death when I saw the snake. 固定搭配：literally meaning, translate literally。原词literal其它变形及搭配：literal(adj. 字面上的) literal translation, literature(n. 文学), literary(adj. 文学的)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。动词offer与其逻辑主语a distinct characteristic之间是被动关系，表示“在家庭聚会等场合被提供”，故使用过去分词offered作后置定语。易错点：容易受思维定式影响误填offering，或写成谓语形式is offered导致单句出现双谓语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(offered)：语境句：The course offered by the university is very popular among students. 固定搭配：offer to do sth, accept an offer。原词offer其它变形及搭配：offer(n./v. 提供) make an offer, offering(n. 供品/提供物) course offerings。

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。local在此处作为名词表示“当地人”，结合句中的early-rising修饰以及后面的each other，说明是指人群群体，需用复数形式locals。易错点：不知道local可作可数名词，或者漏加s。
questions.supplement: 正确形(locals)：语境句：The locals are very friendly and willing to help tourists. 固定搭配：communicate with locals, a favorite with locals。原词local其它变形及搭配：local(adj./n. 当地的/当地人) local government, locally(adv. 当地地) locally grown, localize(v. 本土化)。

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句关系代词。先行词是The only thing，当先行词被the only, the very, 序数词或最高级修饰时，指物关系代词只能用that，在从句中作主语。易错点：容易误填which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：The only thing that matters right now is your safety. 固定搭配：the only thing that, all that matters。补充提示：当先行词是不定代词(如anything, everything)或被特定词修饰时，引导词首选that。

questions.explanation: 考查主谓一致和时态。该句主语是“A native saying”，描述的是一种普遍现象和客观事实，故使用一般现在时；主语为第三人称单数，动词应用shows。易错点：未注意主谓一致，直接填原形show。
questions.supplement: 正确形(shows)：语境句：Research shows that regular exercise can improve mental health. 固定搭配：show off, show up。原词show其它变形及搭配：show(v./n. 展示/演出) on show, showing(n. 表现/展示) a good showing。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。句意为人们聚在茶楼里是为了“探索/品尝”各种美食，表目的需要用动词不定式。易错点：可能受前面come的影响，误填exploring。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to explore)：语境句：We went to the museum to explore the history of ancient Egypt. 固定搭配：explore new opportunities, explore the world。原词explore其它变形及搭配：exploration(n. 探索) space exploration, explorer(n. 探险家) polar explorer。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。add a touch of... 是英语中的固定短语搭配，意为“增添一丝/一点...”，此处表示泛指，故填不定冠词a。易错点：误填the或者对该固定搭配不熟悉。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：A touch of humor can make the speech more engaging. 固定搭配：a touch of, have a touch of (有点儿)。补充提示：类似表示“一种/一份”的冠词搭配有 a variety of, a piece of, a large amount of。

questions.explanation: 考查时态和语态。时间状语“Over the last ten years”标志着谓语动词应用现在完成时；主语the tradition与动词accept之间是被动关系，故使用现在完成时的被动语态has been accepted。易错点：漏掉been写成主动语态，或者时态误用为一般过去时。
questions.supplement: 正确形(has been accepted)：语境句：The new policy has been accepted by the majority of the employees. 固定搭配：be accepted as, generally accepted。原词accept其它变形及搭配：acceptable(adj. 可接受的) socially acceptable, acceptance(n. 接受/接纳) gain acceptance。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。experiment with... 是常用的固定搭配，意为“用...做实验/尝试...”，符合句中尝试各种创新点心的语意。易错点：介词搭配记忆不牢，受中文影响误填on或in。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The chef likes to experiment with different spices in his cooking. 固定搭配：experiment with, deal with, cope with。补充提示：with常表示“用、使用”的工具或对象。

questions.explanation: 考查名词。在此句中，空前有指示代词This，空后有介词of，结合句子结构需要填入名词形式combination作主语，意为“传统与创新的结合”。易错点：拼写错误，如保留e直接加tion写成combinetion。
questions.supplement: 正确形(combination)：语境句：The dish is a perfect combination of sweet and sour flavors. 固定搭配：a combination of, in combination with。原词combine其它变形及搭配：combine(v. 结合) combine A with B, combined(adj. 结合的) combined efforts。

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely noticeable or exceptional
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用作形容词修饰 tradition，意为“突出的传统”。standout 为复合形容词，通常作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her performance was the standout moment of the show.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的表演是这场演出中最突出的时刻。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that something is actually true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰动名词 meaning，意为“字面意思是”。literally 是副词，位于动词前。
vocab_pack.example_en: He literally jumped for joy when he heard the news.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听到这个消息，他 literally 高兴得跳了起来。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that something is not limited to a particular description
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中用于强调 Yum Cha 不仅是一种饮品，更是一种社交活动。固定结构，后接名词或名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's more than just a job; it's a career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这不仅仅是一份工作，更是一份事业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Yum Cha is more than just a drink

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate that something belongs to a particular category
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中表示“一种社交活动”，用于引出类别。a kind of 后接名词单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's a kind of fruit that grows in tropical regions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是一种生长在热带地区的水果。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it's a kind of social activity

vocab_pack.definition_en: a clear and noticeable feature or quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 distinct 修饰 characteristic，意为“显著的特征”，characteristic 为可数名词单数，前面有不定冠词 a。
vocab_pack.example_en: One distinct characteristic of her writing is its vivid imagery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她写作的一个显著特征是其生动的意象。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a distinct characteristic of Lingnan culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide or supply something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 offered 是过去分词作后置定语，修饰 activity，相当于“which is offered”，表示被动。注意 offer 常搭配介词 in 表示在某种场合提供。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel offers free breakfast for all guests.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家酒店为所有客人提供免费早餐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: offered in family gatherings, business meetings, or casual chats

vocab_pack.definition_en: tending to get up early in the morning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 early-rising 修饰 locals，是复合形容词作定语，由 early 和 rising 构成。
vocab_pack.example_en: Early-rising people often enjoy the quiet morning hours.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 早起的人常常享受安静的清晨时光。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to welcome or address someone using a particular expression or action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中主语为复数 locals，一般现在时 greet（原形），each other 表示相互，with 引出问候的内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: They greet each other with a warm hug.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们用热情的拥抱互相问候。
vocab_pack.from_passage: usually greet each other with 'Have you drunk tea?'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consume tea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 drunk 是 drink 的过去分词，用于现在完成时 Have you drunk tea? 注意 drink 的过去分词不规则。此处为固定搭配，表示喝茶的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Do you like to drink tea in the afternoon?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你喜欢下午喝茶吗？

vocab_pack.definition_en: a local proverb or traditional expression
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 native 作形容词修饰 saying，意为“当地谚语”，saying 是可数名词单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: A native saying from the village warns against walking alone at night.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 村里的一句当地谚语警告人们不要独自夜行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A native saying, 'The only thing that can interrupt...'

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a humorous or playful manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 jokingly 与 vividly 并列修饰动词 shows，表示“开玩笑但生动地展示”。副词作状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He jokingly called me a 'superstar'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他开玩笑地叫我'超级巨星'。

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that produces clear and powerful images in the mind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 vividly 修饰动词 shows，与 jokingly 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The experience is vividly described in her memoir.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个经历在她的回忆录中被生动地描述。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a firm dedication or devotion to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 strong 修饰 commitment，作 shows 的宾语。commitment 后常接 to doing sth。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has a strong commitment to environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对环境保护有强烈的投入。
vocab_pack.from_passage: shows the strong commitment of Guangzhou people

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gather or meet as a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中主语 people，一般现在时 come（原形），表示人们聚集在一起。come together 为不及物动词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Families come together for the holiday celebration.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 家人聚集在一起庆祝节日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: people come together to explore a wide variety

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large and diverse range of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中后接 traditional bite-sized foods，表示种类繁多。固定搭配，后接复数名词或不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The store sells a wide variety of books.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家店出售各种各样的书籍。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a wide variety of traditional bite-sized foods

vocab_pack.definition_en: small enough to be eaten in one bite
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 bite-sized 修饰 foods，复合形容词作定语，意为“一口大小的食物”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The recipe calls for bite-sized pieces of chicken.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个食谱需要一口大小的鸡肉块。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the general mood or feeling of a social gathering
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 enjoying the social atmosphere，动名词短语的宾语，social 修饰 atmosphere。
vocab_pack.example_en: The social atmosphere at the party was lively and friendly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 派对上的社交氛围既活泼又友好。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a valuable and abundant cultural legacy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 rich 修饰 cultural heritage，作宾语，heritage 为不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city is known for its rich cultural heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市以其丰富的文化遗产而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: rich cultural heritage that accompany the meal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go with or be present at something as a companion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 accompany 为动词原形，定语从句 that accompany the meal 中，that 指代 the social atmosphere and rich cultural heritage，为复数主语，所以用原形。常搭配 with。
vocab_pack.example_en: The main course is accompanied by a side salad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 主菜配有一份配菜沙拉。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a small amount or hint of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 adds a touch of depth and enjoyment，a touch of 后接不可数名词，表示“少许深度和享受”。固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: Add a touch of lemon juice to brighten the flavor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 加一点点柠檬汁提亮味道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: adds a touch of depth and enjoyment

vocab_pack.definition_en: during the past decade
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作时间状语，表示“在过去的十年中”，常用于现在完成时态。over 表示“在……期间”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Over the last ten years, technology has changed dramatically.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在过去的十年里，技术发生了巨大变化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Over the last ten years, the tradition of Yum Cha has been accepted

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive or agree to something offered
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 has been accepted 是现在完成时的被动语态，accepted 为过去分词，主语 the tradition of Yum Cha 被接受。注意 accept 的常用搭配：accept as/into。
vocab_pack.example_en: She finally accepted the job offer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她最终接受了这份工作邀请。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has been accepted by many young people

vocab_pack.definition_en: to establish a connection again with someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 a way to reconnect with their roots，不定式短语作定语，reconnect 是不及物动词后接 with，表示与根源重新建立联系。
vocab_pack.example_en: He moved back to his hometown to reconnect with his childhood friends.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他搬回老家，重新联系儿时的朋友。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a way to reconnect with their roots

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make changes or introduce new ideas in relation to an existing thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 they are innovating on the classic Yum Cha，现在进行时，innovating on 意为“在经典早茶基础上创新”。innovate 常与 on/upon 搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company is innovating on its existing product line.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司正在其现有产品线上进行创新。
vocab_pack.from_passage: they are innovating on the classic Yum Cha

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try different methods or ingredients to see what works
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 experimenting with 是现在分词，与前面 innovating 并列，表示“尝试低糖、低油、高纤维的点心”。experiment with 后接名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She likes to experiment with new recipes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她喜欢尝试新食谱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: experimenting with low-sugar, low-oil, and high-fiber dim sum

vocab_pack.definition_en: containing a large amount of dietary fiber
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 high-fiber 修饰 dim sum，复合形容词作定语，与 low-sugar, low-oil 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: Whole grains are a good source of high-fiber foods.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 全谷物是高纤维食物的良好来源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: low-sugar, low-oil, and high-fiber dim sum

vocab_pack.definition_en: not harmful to the environment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 eco-friendly 修饰 tea ware，复合形容词作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should use eco-friendly products to reduce pollution.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该使用环保产品以减少污染。

vocab_pack.definition_en: utensils used for preparing and drinking tea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 tea ware 为不可数名词，与 recyclable and eco-friendly 搭配，作介词 using 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The traditional tea ware includes teapots, cups, and trays.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 传统茶具包括茶壶、杯子和托盘。
vocab_pack.from_passage: using recyclable and eco-friendly tea ware

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act or result of combining two or more things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 this combination of tradition and innovation 作主语，combination 常与 of 搭配，表示结合。
vocab_pack.example_en: The combination of hard work and talent led to her success.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 努力与天赋的结合促成了她的成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This combination of tradition and innovation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to be important or applicable
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 保持相关性；仍然有意义
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 remains relevant 为系表结构，主语为 Yum Cha culture，一般现在时第三人称单数，remain 为系动词，relevant 为形容词作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: In a fast-changing world, old traditions must evolve to remain relevant.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在瞬息万变的世界中，旧传统必须演变才能保持相关性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: helps ensure that Yum Cha culture remains relevant

vocab_pack.definition_en: happening very quickly and with a lot of activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fast-paced 修饰 world，复合形容词作定语，表示“快节奏的世界”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She enjoys the fast-paced environment of a newsroom.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她喜欢新闻编辑室那种快节奏的环境。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make certain that something happens or is the case
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 help ensure that...，ensure 后接 that 从句，help 后省略了 to 的不定式，ensure 为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please ensure that all doors are locked before leaving.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请确保离开前所有门都已锁好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: helps ensure that Yum Cha culture remains relevant
